ORDINANCE XIX of 1984
ORDINANCE XIX of 1984
AGRICULTURAL CENSUS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1984
An Ordinance further to amend the Agricultural Census Act, 1958
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 22nd April, 1984]
No. F. 17 (1)/84-Pub.--The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information :-
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called
the Agricultural Census (Amendment) Ordinance, 1984.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 5, Act XLI of 1958

No. F. 17 (1)/84-Pub.--The

2. Amendment of section 5, Act XLI of 1958.--In the Agricultural
Census Act, 1958 (XLI of 1958), in section 5, in subsection (3), after the word
"experi ments", the words and comma "as is not less than such
loss or damage, and the assessment of the loss or damage shall be carried out
in such manner" shall be inserted.
